p: the city to draw near: The time to take vengeance.
men came from the way of: Which were angels in the appearance of men.
north: Signifying that the Babylonians would come from the north to destroy the city and the temple.
inkhorn by his side: To mark them that would be saved.
gone up from the cherub: Which declared that he was not bound to it, neither would remain any longer than there was hope that they would return from their wickedness and worship him correctly.

sigh and that cry for all: He shows what is the manner of God's children, whom he marks for salvation: that is, to mourn and cry out against the wickedness which they see committed against God's glory.

mark: Thus in all his plagues the Lord preserves his small number, which he marks as in Ex 12:12, Re 7:3 but the chief mark is the spirit of adoption, with which the heart is sealed up to life everlasting.
elders who were before the house: Which was the chief opportunity for all these evils, as in Eze 8:11.
Ah Lord GOD: This declares that the servants of God have a compassion when they see his judgments executed.
blood: That is, with all kinds of wickedness. See Geneva "Isa 1:15"
